stories.headline: JioStar To Cut 150 Jobs To Control Costs
stories.summary: JioStar, the joint venture between Reliance Industries and Disney Star, is reportedly laying off around 150 employees as part of cost-control measures. The job cuts follow the completion of the Reliance-Disney media merger in India and are expected to primarily affect mid-level to senior management positions.

stories.headline: Banks, card networks raid Safaricom, Airtel and MTN for top talent
stories.summary: African banks and Visa have recruited at least six senior executives from major telecom and mobile money operators, including Safaricom, M-PESA Africa, Airtel Money, and MTN. The strategic talent movement underscores intensifying competition between traditional financial institutions and mobile wallet providers to capture retail digital payments and integrated financial services across the region.

stories.headline: ‘GTA 6’ Is a Birder’s Paradise
stories.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI features over 170 animal species, including 62 accurately rendered bird species modeled after Florida's native wildlife. The high level of detail in the game's environment has led birdwatchers and streamers to conduct specialized birdwatching runs within the virtual world.
